store_data.about_the_game:
There was a time when adventures weren’t just played… they were written.
In Panspermia, you recover that classic essence and take it to a new level. A narrative experience where every action begins with your own words.

Explore an unknown world, unravel its mysteries, and make decisions that will shape your path. Nothing is completely defined… because you are part of the story.

A UNIVERSE THAT EVOLVES

Set in the universe of the novel Panspermia, this video game is not an adaptation, but a spin-off that expands the story from a new perspective.

WRITE YOUR OWN ADVENTURE

Interact with the world through a command-based system:

Examine your surroundings

Manipulate objects

Make key decisions

Every word can change the course of the story.

EXPLORATION AND DISCOVERY

Atmospheric locations

Objects with multiple uses

Hidden secrets waiting to be discovered

Not everything is in plain sight.

AN ATMOSPHERIC EXPERIENCE

Immerse yourself in a unique setting accompanied by an original soundtrack, designed to enhance every moment of the adventure.

A TRIBUTE TO THE CLASSICS

Inspired by the text parser adventures of the 1980s, playable on systems such as Spectrum, Amstrad, MSX… but adapted into a modern experience.

Are you ready to imagine again?

👉 Add it to your wishlist and get ready to explore Panspermia.

store_data.about_the_game:
A fast-paced, light Roguelike game with dozens of random events. With simple controls, combine buffs to continuously climb to higher scores.

Gameplay

Dodge the boss's attacks and the onslaught of numerous enemies. Find the rhythm through simple controls and knock enemies flying. Combine the buffs granted by various random events to create unexpected attack effects, keep pushing your score higher, and challenge the boss.

Random Events

Various random events appear and disappear quickly. Do your best to make full use of the buffs, while remembering to dodge the boss's random attacks.

store_data.about_the_game:
Backrooms: Fade is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Alone or with friends, you will explore a nightmarish level, trying to understand where you are, what is happening, and how to survive.

Features

  • Terrifying atmosphere

  • 1–4 player co-op

  • Proximity voice chat

  • Immersive AI

  • Multiple difficulty settings

  • Stealth gameplay

  • Large and challenging map

  • Simple yet unforgiving gameplay

Important Notes

This is not a typical Backrooms game. It does not follow every detail from the online community lore. Instead, it presents a unique interpretation, combining selected elements into a fresh and atmospheric experience.

The game contains flickering lights and audiovisual effects that may affect sensitive players.dynamic visibility system based on movement, posture, and flashlight use.

store_data.about_the_game:
Backrooms: Blackhole is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1–4 players. Somewhere deep within the endless halls, reality begins collapsing into a growing void that consumes light, sound, and everything around it. The deeper you descend, the less the world makes sense — and the harder it becomes to tell what is real.

Play alone or with friends as you explore unstable environments, avoid hostile entities, and uncover the origin of a phenomenon that should never have existed.

Features

  • Dark and oppressive psychological horror atmosphere

  • Online co-op for 1–4 players

  • Proximity voice chat

  • Reactive and unpredictable enemy AI

  • Multiple difficulty modes

  • Stealth-focused survival gameplay

  • Large nonlinear environments with hidden paths and dangers

  • Tension-driven exploration and resource management

  • Dynamic visibility system affected by movement, shadows, posture, and flashlight usage

Important Notes

This game is inspired by the Backrooms concept but presents its own original interpretation rather than strictly following existing community lore. The experience focuses on isolation, fear of the unknown, and distorted environments designed to feel increasingly surreal and hostile.

The game contains flickering lights, disturbing imagery, loud noises, darkness effects, and intense audiovisual sequences that may affect sensitive players.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Last Braincell: Escape is a humorous, asymmetrical multiplayer game in which one player takes on the role of the fugitive, while the others cooperate as the police. The fugitive tries to gather resources, conceal their identity, and reach the escape point, while the officers collect clues, search the area, and coordinate the pursuit.

Main characters:

Fugitive (Orange Braincell)

Clever, chaotic, and definitely way too confident. His goal is to disappear off the map, secure a fake identity, and reach the escape point before the police cut off every possible route. He can improvise, hide in absurd places, and pull off ideas that sound terrible on paper but somehow work.

Police Officer (Blue Braincell)

Alert, stubborn, and fully prepared to search half the map over a single suspicious report. He operates based on clues, tips from civilians, and coordination with other officers. He must quickly assess situations, secure areas, and anticipate the fugitive’s moves before he vanishes across the border. 

Goals in the game :

Prototype build. Release date: TBD. Wishlist now!

store_data.about_the_game:
Idlemoor is a dark fantasy idle RPG set in a persistent online realm of ruined settlements, grim barrows, and slow-burning character growth.

Choose how your character survives: fight enemies, train combat styles, gather resources, craft gear, trade with other players, fight against other players in PvP, and climb the rankings. Progress continues while you are away, but active players can make sharper decisions, react to community events & random events, manage the market, and push deeper into the world.

Core Features

Persistent online progression
Your character keeps advancing over time through server-side saves and account-based progress.

Combat, training, gathering, and PvP battlegrounds
Fight players & creatures, improve combat stats, mine, woodcut, forage, skin animals, and build your character through multiple highly-connected complex gear & stat systems! 

Player economy
Buy, sell, and trade through a shared marketplace where player activity shapes item movement.  Each item is totally unique, and will never drop with identical stats.  Build your character with multiple in-depth skill systems, as well as several stat and gear systems that connect to form a complex meta-game of infinite potential choices!

Community features
Chat with other players, compete on rankings, engage in community events every day, and take part in a persistent realm instead of a purely local idle game.

Idle Pacing
Idlemoor is built for long-term progression: short check-ins, longer grinds, rare drops, and slow accumulation of power.

store_data.about_the_game:
Spin. Win. Collect. Repeat.

Reel Greed is a slot machine incremental where every win turns into a shower of physical money pickups. Start with tiny payouts, collect every bill you can, and build a machine that grows faster, stronger, and more ridiculous with every upgrade.

Each run gives you new chances to improve your setup. Pick powerful run cards, unlock permanent upgrades, increase your payouts, speed up the reels, and turn small wins into room-filling cash explosions.

The more you play, the more the machine changes. Spins get faster. Rewards get bigger. Coins unlock new paths. Cards create temporary power spikes. Before long, a few harmless payouts can turn into a chaotic pile of money covering the screen.

From Pocket Change to Ridiculous Wealth

Every run gives you new ways to scale:

- Increase starting chips, bet value, and payout multipliers

- Unlock new patterns and stronger upgrade paths

- Pick run cards that boost your current or next run

- Improve coin drops, collection range, and spin speed

- Build combinations that turn simple wins into huge payouts

- Watch money pile up, fade, and get collected

Features

- Money and coin pickups that fall, pile up, and flood the screen

- Permanent upgrade tree with branching paths

- Run cards that create short-term build choices

- Pattern-based slot payouts with scaling multipliers

- Fast, satisfying incremental progression

- Chaotic money explosions from big wins

- Short-session friendly, with plenty of room to keep pushing further

store_data.about_the_game:
Vector Storm is a fast-paced top-down arcade shooter that rewards aggression, precision, and smart builds.

Fight through endless waves of escalating enemies, survive devastating boss encounters, and grow stronger with every

run.

Survive. Build. Repeat.

Each run drops you into an arena that gets deadlier by the wave. Clear enemies to earn credits, spend them in the

mid-run shop on weapons and upgrades, and scavenge gear from fallen bosses. Die, bank your tokens, and come back

stronger.

Build Your Loadout

Equip tiered gear across seven slots — cockpit, wings, boosters, plating, shield, dampener, and weapon bay. Every

piece changes how your ship performs. Stack synergies, push your combo multiplier, and find the build that carries you

deepest.

Five Ships. Five Playstyles.

Start with the balanced Viper or unlock faster, stranger ships as you clear waves. The heavy Bastion regenerates

shields. The Phantom opens with a stealth window. The Ironclad reflects damage back. Each ship demands a different

approach.

Meta-Progression

Tokens earned each run fund permanent upgrades — more health, faster fire rate, bonus starting credits, and more. Sink

enough tokens into the tree and the arena changes with you.

Features

[] Endless wave-based survival with escalating difficulty

[] Seven-slot gear system with tiered boss drops

[] Five unlockable ships with unique passives

[] Deep mid-run upgrade shop

[] Persistent meta-progression across runs

[] Multiple distinct boss encounters

[] 44 Steam achievements

[] Global leaderboards

[*] Procedurally generated adaptive soundtrack
